name: Anhui Jialiqi Advanced Composites Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Anhui Jialiqi Advanced Composites Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the entire process, from research and development to the production and sale, of advanced composite components designed for aircraft and missile applications. These specialized parts are utilized across a wide array of aerial platforms, including fighter jets, transport aircraft, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), training planes, target drones, and various missile systems. The company, which was founded in 2004, is based in Suzhou, China.
